The original high-dimensional neural network potential (Behler and Parrinello, 2007) uses a piece-wise cosine cutoff. It is fc(Rij) = 0.5[cos(π Rij/Rc) + 1] for Rij ≤ Rc, and 0 for Rij > Rc [W2025444507#004]. The cutoff is written in the same form in the ANI paper, as 0.5 × cos(π Rij/RC) + 0.5 for Rij ≤ RC [W2541404351#007].
